name: Interrupting Politely
equipment: A notebook and a colleague or mirror to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on interrupting politely -- practice these key phrases out loud:
Sorry to jump in, but I wanted to add something here.
Can I just come in on that point quickly?
If I could just add a thought before we move on...
Sorry to interrupt -- one quick clarification first.
Try using at least two of these phrases in a short role-play scenario at work.
